description: Recommend the best AI node + model for a task, with an enforceable cost estimate and human-readable reasons. Use this first when you know the task but not the model. Pass `task` (sent to this registry, which extracts features and discards the text) or `features` already extracted on your side with extractFeatures from @opennodes/core, which keeps the prompt private. Returns ranked candidates with score components, a cost estimate pinned to the node's card revision, an optional cheaper two-step scenario, and MCP tool categories the task likely needs. To browse instead, use search_offerings; to price a specific chain, use estimate.

est_output_tokens.description: Expected answer length in tokens, if known. Improves the cost estimate; otherwise inferred from the task.

features.description: Features from extractFeatures(prompt) in @opennodes/core: task class, size, language and needs, no prompt text. Give this or `task`.

policy.description: Optional constraints and preferences for the recommendation.

jurisdiction.description: Only operators in this jurisdiction: "eea" or ISO country codes ("DE,FI"). Local and LAN models always qualify.

max_input_per_mtok.description: Maximum input price in USD per million tokens.

max_total_usd.description: Maximum estimated total cost of the call in USD.

min_tier.description: Exclude offerings below this trust tier.

prefer_local.description: Give a bonus to nodes on this machine or LAN.

preset.description: Weighting preset: cheap favours price, fast favours latency/throughput, quality favours model strength, private favours trust tier.

region.description: Required data region, e.g. "eu". Offerings pinned to other regions are excluded.

task.description: The task description or the prompt itself. Sent to the registry for feature extraction; use `features` to keep it private. Give this or `features`.

name: recommend
title: Recommend a node and model
